title: Movie Reviews
article:
There are two new movies that have come out this September! One is called Transformers One. The true origin of how Megatron and Optimus Prime came to exist! In this hilarious action movie, Orion Pax and D-16 become best friends—only to later become bitter enemies. They eventually report to waste management and meet B-127 (aka Badassatron). They then go to the surface with their friends where they learn a dark secret about their mined Energon. You can officially witness the origin of the Transformers now on the big screen.

Another new movie that came out this September is The Wild Robot. This amazing, award- winning book will now be witnessed on the big screen. The Wild Robot is a book about a robot named Roz encounters the wilderness and learns to survive, while making sure that her adopted son is well protected from the elements. This touching, yet exciting motion picture is in theaters now.

There is also a movie coming out in April 2025. This iconic video game has officially become a movie to be seen on the big screen. The Minecraft Movie is a story when four people get transported into minecraft and must defeat the pigmen army while meeting some iconic things in the minecraft world along the way, such as Steve, an iconic character skin, the extremely rare pink sheep, and learn to craft different items.

Some movies people have loved are Transformers One (see above for more info), Despicable Me 4 (the next movie in the Despicable Me series), and Harry Potter (the amazing story of a young orphan learning that he belongs in the Wizarding World). Two theaters near us are Cobble Hill Cinemas and the Alamo Drafthouse. Another new movie that has come out this October is Piece By Piece. A new Lego movie has been released starring Farrell Williams, a famous Hip Hop singer.
author: Elijah Kalista
